<p>Do all uses of this <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> need the result in a GPR?</p>


<p>This is meant to be used on values that have type i1 since it is somewhat meaningless to ask if values of other types should be kept in GPR's.</p>
